feeds.title: Making Sense Of Cents Blog
feeds.description: My name is Michelle and I'm the author/owner of Making Sense Of Cents. Learning how to save money and make more money changed my life. It allowed me to pay off $40,000 in student loans, start my own business, and I now travel full-time.

feeds.title: Financial Samurai
feeds.description: Financial Samurai delves deeper into investing, real estate, retirement planning, and career strategies, to achieve financial independence sooner, rather than later. Every article is written based on firsthand experience to provide the most helpful insights possible. Financial Samurai is one of the largest independently-owned personal finance sites in the world.

feeds.title: FinGlimpse
feeds.description: FinGlimpse discusses various topics related to financial markets and global economic trends. It covers the concept of carbon markets, the EU's AI regulation, China's export rebound, the Indian stock market, Saudi Arabia's economic diversification, the appointment of Deven Parekh to the IDFC board, Japan's economic contraction, the funding crisis in Ukraine, and the paradigm shift towards ESG investing.

feeds.title: The College Investor
feeds.description: The College Investor helps you get out of student loan debt to start investing, generating passive income, and building wealth for the future. Our expert guides, reviews, and more are designed to help you achieve your financial goals.

feeds.title: Clever Girl Finance Blog
feeds.description: Voted one of the top personal finance websites for women, Clever Girl Finance is a financial education platform aimed at providing women with financial guidance that will inspire them to pursue and achieve their dreams of financial independence.

feeds.title: Best Wallet Hacks
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Jim. I've been writing about personal finance for over 15+ years. I share the money tips, tricks, and strategies I use to manage our finances, invest wisely, use credit responsibly, and get the most from our money.

feeds.title: Mr. Money Mustache Blog
feeds.description: Mr. Money Mustache is a 30 something retiree who now writes about how we can all lead a frugal yet Badass life of leisure. I decided to start this blog to share some of the secrets of how all this can be done. How you can create a life that is better than your current one, that just happens to cost 50-75% less.

feeds.title: Rob Berger
feeds.description: The Dough Roller is a blog about money. How to make it, give it, save it, and spend it in a way that moves us closer to financial freedom. We discuss everything from asset allocation to zero-coupon bonds, from savings yields to real estate investing, and from raising financially fit kids to raising financially fit parents.

feeds.title: Mariner Finance Blog
feeds.description: Discover tips and financial guidance to simplify your life on our blog. Mariner Finance provides hard-working consumers responsible access to credit through respectful, compassionate, and efficient service. We'll match you with a personal loan near you that meets your immediate needs and helps you realize your long-term dreams.

feeds.title: Kitces.com
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Michael, and I'm a bit of a nerd when it comes to financial planning. And as a lifelong learner of all things financial planning, I know how hard it is to find good information. I launched Kitces.com in 2008. As a way to share this continuous learning journey that I'm on, and provide anyone and everyone who can find their way here that source for intellectually honest, knowledgeable, thoughtful information that I was always looking for.

feeds.title: Financial Panther
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Kevin. I started this blog to share what I've learned about money and side hustling over the years, as well as to document my own journey towards financial independence. As a lawyer and dentist couple, I like to think that this blog can be a particularly helpful resource for future or current lawyers, doctors, dentists, or anyone else with a solid income, too much debt, and not enough knowledge about what to do with it.

feeds.title: Seedtime Blog
feeds.description: Hey! I'm Bob Lotich. This site contains the lessons I learned on my journey from being a stingy, debt-ridden fool, to being able to give more than I ever dreamed, having a paid off house by age 31, and joy with money in the process.

feeds.title: My Money Blog
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Jonathan and I've been sharing my discoveries about money since 2004. I'm a father, husband, self-directed investor, financial freedom enthusiast, and perpetual learner.

feeds.title: The Financial Diet
feeds.description: This is the place where you will start talking about money for the first time in a way that doesn't feel scary, judgmental, or boring as hell. We have thousands of articles that you should read about everything from investing on a budget to what foods are really worth the organic price tag, but we believe there are a few key places you should start.

feeds.title: Monevator
feeds.description: Monevator is a personal blog about money: making, saving, growing, and sometimes even spending it. From passive investing with index trackers funds to choosing the cheapest investment platform or broker, Monevator is essential reading for all British investors.

feeds.title: Radical FIRE
feeds.description: I'm Marjolein, and I decided in 2018 to turn my finances around. I want to become financially free and live the life of my dreams. Radical FIRE is a personal finance platform that is all about financial independence. At Radical FIRE, you will learn to save money, make more money, and invest to optimize your way to freedom. We want you to reach your financial goals and have fun while doing it!

feeds.title: Passive Income M.D Blog
feeds.description: My name is Peter and I'm an anesthesiologist living in Los Angeles, trying to make it in one of the most expensive cities in the world. This blog will serve as a personal documentation of my journey to find ways to achieve passive income, which will ultimately allow me to spend more time with loved ones. Follow this blog as I share my ideas on financial freedom through passive income.

feeds.title: Budgets Are Sexy
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Joel. For me, the Budgets Are Sexy blog has always been about the community. Sharing cool ideas, sharing lessons learned, and making money is a FUN topic to talk about! I believe everyone's path to financial independence is slightly different, and I'm excited to share more about mine.

feeds.title: Money Ning
feeds.description: Sharing insights since 2007 on carefully saving money, investing, frugal living, coupons, promo codes because the little things matter in achieving financial freedom!

feeds.title: Afford Anything Blog
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Paula. Afford Anything explores the answers to these two critical questions - How can we make smarter decisions about our money, time, and life? How can we align our daily behaviors and habits with the lifestyle we value most? This is a website and podcast that explores behavioral finance, personal development, and financial independence.

feeds.title: Money Smart Guides
feeds.description: Money Smart Guides serves as a comprehensive resource dedicated to enhancing individuals' financial well-being, enabling them to pursue their dream lifestyles. With a commitment to guiding individuals at any starting point, whether drowning in debt or lacking budgeting skills, they provide step-by-step support towards success. Categorized articles cater to diverse needs, empowering readers to pay off debt, amass wealth, and realize their aspirations.

feeds.title: Penny Pinchin Mom Blog
feeds.description: Hii! I'm Tracie! I am a mom of 3 amazing kids! I share tips to help people get out of debt, save money, budget, make amazing recipes, parenting tips, and more!

feeds.title: Financial Gym Blog
feeds.description: Find tips on paying off student loans, credit scores, navigating the business world, and more. The Financial Gym is your one-stop source for getting your finances in shape so you can get and stay financially fit. We exist to help people with an affordable and trustworthy option to achieve financial freedom.

feeds.title: Everything Finance Blog
feeds.description: Welcome to Everything Finance, your one-stop shop for financial information on everything! We have been providing valuable personal finance resources since 2007 covering every topic imaginable including investing, saving money, shopping, making extra money, blogging, traveling, parenting, and working online.

feeds.title: Lazy Man and Money Blog
feeds.description: Lazy Man and Money is my personal journal where I explore how I can save money and make more money. I try to cover topics such as banking, budgeting, career, credit, debt, entrepreneurship, investing, taxes, real estate, insurance, spending, retirement, and estate planning.

feeds.title: The Best Interest Blog
feeds.description: Hello! I'm Jesse Cramer, the creator of The Best Interest. I started The Best Interest in 2018. It was started as a creative outlet, but it gained recognition for explaining complex personal finance ideas in simple terms. You can read articles on Money Basics, Behavioral economics, Investing, and Retirement.

feeds.title: The Define Financial Blog
feeds.description: The Define Financial blog is where we teach you how to invest smarter, save more money, reduce taxes, and make smart decisions with your money. The financial information and articles are completely free for you to enjoy.

feeds.title: My Own Advisor
feeds.description: My name is Mark Seed and I'm the editor, founder, and owner of My Own Advisor. Personal finance and investing is a growing passion of mine and I will be using this site to post my thoughts, opinions, and journey to financial freedom being my own DIY financial advisor.

feeds.title: rich & REGULAR Blog
feeds.description: We, Julien and Kiersten Saunders started rich & REGULAR in 2017 to help people who are doing everything right but still not getting results. Our blog is a place where we not only share people's frustration but offer solutions to a richer and happier life, pursue financial independence, and plan for paying off debt, improving credit, and investing.

feeds.title: Getting Your Financial Ducks In A Row
feeds.description: Jim Blankenship, CFP, EA, is an independent, fee-only financial planner. This blog is primarily dedicated to discussions and information on personal income tax, detailing many of the provisions of IRA and other retirement plan rules, as well as advice, thoughts, and recommendations with regard to pretty much anything financially related.

feeds.title: The Debt Myth
feeds.description: The Debt Myth at JackieBeck.com is the go-to resource for information and inspiration on getting out of debt, money management, and credit. Founded in 2011 by debt expert Jackie Beck, it's designed for people who want to learn how to manage their money and get out of debt without putting their life on hold.

feeds.title: Time In the Market
feeds.description: Time in the Market is a blog about saving money and living well. Here I'll talk about money in an easy to understand way. However, I know that life isn't just about money. Living well is a key component and I'll cover topics ranging from health to lifestyle to travel.

feeds.title: Good Financial Cents
feeds.description: Take charge of your money and secure a brighter financial future with Jeff Rose, CFP® and the founder of Good Financial Cents, serving readers since 2008.

feeds.title: Get Rich Slowly
feeds.description: Hi, I'm J.D. Roth. I started to Get Rich Slowly in 2006 to share what I learned as I dug out of debt. Here you'll find common-sense advice and money-saving tips on topics from high-interest savings accounts, frugality, cd rates, money market accounts, mortgage rates, how to get out of debt, money management, and more.

feeds.title: Finance Conductor
feeds.description: Welcome to Finance Conductor, your premier destination for insightful and impactful finance-related blogs. At Finance Conductor, we understand the ever-evolving landscape of the finance industry and the importance of staying informed. Our mission is to be your trusted guide in navigating the intricate world of finance through engaging and informative content.

feeds.title: Stories by Thomas Guenter
feeds.description: Read writing from Thomas Guenter on Medium. Finance enthusiast, passionate about problem-solving and investing.

feeds.title: Side Hustle Nation Blog
feeds.description: The web's leading blog, podcast, and community for aspiring and part-time entrepreneurs building meaningful income on their own terms. Explore legit ways to make money outside of your day job, build a business you love, and escape the rat race. Side Hustle Nation is the #1 community and resource for side hustle ideas and part-time entrepreneurs on the path to financial independence.

feeds.title: Millennial Money » Investing
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Grant Sabatier, the creator of Millennial Money. Making financial freedom accessible to all is my mission and passion. Since 2015, more than 10 million readers have visited Millennial Money to learn about how to save more money, start a side hustle, make more money, invest intelligently, fast-track financial independence, and reach early retirement.

feeds.title: The Savvy Couple Blog
feeds.description: The Savvy Couple is a family finance blog that makes personal finance approachable, fun, and easy to understand. Our team of personal finance experts breaks down personal finance into clear and practical advice anyone can follow to improve their finances, increase their income, and create a life of freedom!

feeds.title: FinMasters
feeds.description: FinMasters covers advice to fix your finances and take charge of your money, information and tools that help you understand everything you need to set you on a path to financial success. FinMasters' mission is to give you the right information, resources & tools to reach your financial goals.

feeds.title: Vital Dollar Blog
feeds.description: VitalDollar.com, curated by founder Marc, offers a wealth of resources spanning basic personal finance to online money-making strategies. Tailored for anyone seeking financial improvement, it serves as a haven for managing money, saving, and boosting income. Dive into VitalDollar.com to embark on your journey towards financial success.

feeds.title: The Simple Dollar
feeds.description: The Simple Dollar is a free resource for all things finance. Learn about budgeting, investing, credit, and more to take control of your financial destiny.

feeds.title: Bible Money Matters
feeds.description: Welcome to BibleMoneyMatters.com - a Christian personal finance blog that helps regular people gain control of their finances and live financially free. Hopefully, Bible Money Matters can play a small part in helping you create your financial blueprint so that down the road you can give more, save more and live more!

feeds.title: Women Who Money Blog
feeds.description: Women Who Money is a personal finance site for women, by women, to provide trustworthy information on all things money-related. We want to help you eliminate debt, save smarter, build wealth, and become financially independent. We publish well-researched, informational articles to help you improve your financial life.

feeds.title: MapleMoney
feeds.description: I'm Tom Drake, the founder and writer behind MapleMoney. No matter where you are on your financial journey, I'm here to help you reach your goals, so you can live the life you want.MapleMoney is the personal finance source for ways to save money, make money, invest money and spend money wisely.

feeds.title: Wallet Squirrel
feeds.description: Wallet Squirrel is a stand out personal finance blog by best friends, Andrew and Adam.Data shows most people struggle to save money with a stagnant income. So we focus on discovering the internet's most creative ways to make extra money and the benefits if that money was cleverly invested.

feeds.title: Fitnancials Blog
feeds.description: Are you ready to be debt-free, save money for your future, spend money on things you enjoy? My name's Alexis, I'm here to show you how. I help women crush their money goals by taking control of their finances and earning more money.

feeds.title: Frugalwoods Blog
feeds.description: I'm Liz, better known as Mrs. Frugalwoods, and I write about a wide range of topics, including my experiences as a parent, my adventures as a novice homesteader, and the financial decisions that made our life possible. A primary focus of my writing is on saving money, because that's what I most enjoy writing about, but investing and income are key elements of financial independence and topics that I touch on periodically.

feeds.title: The Mini Millionaire
feeds.description: Hello, I'm The Mini Millionaire.I've been committed to helping you make and save money through techniques shared here on The Mini Millionaire for over five years.

feeds.title: My Fab Finance Blog
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Tonya Rapley. I know how it feels to be depressed and ashamed about money, and that's why I created My Fab Finance. My goal is to help you own your power and break the cycle of living paycheck to paycheck so that you can live free and do more of what you love.

feeds.title: Cash Flow Diaries
feeds.description: My name is Alexander and I am on the road to financial freedom. I created this blog to be used as a personal diary (cash flow diary if you will) to track my journey. It will be a journey of ups and downs while I build enough passive income to retire early and reach financial freedom.

feeds.title: The Penny Hoarder
feeds.description: Founded in 2010, The Penny Hoarder is one of the nation's largest personal finance websites. Its purpose is to help people take control of their personal finances and make smart money decisions by sharing actionable articles and resources on how to earn, save and manage money.

feeds.title: Money Under 30
feeds.description: Money Under 30 is an independent personal finance site providing free advice for young adults wanting to make informed decisions about where their money goes. This site was founded in 2006 by David Weliver, who dug himself out of more than $80,000 in debt in just three years.

feeds.title: Credit Karma
feeds.description: Intuit MintLife Blog is your one-stop for personal finance news and advice. Intuit is the global technology platform that helps consumers and small businesses overcome their most important financial challenges.

feeds.title: SavingAdvice.com
feeds.description: Welcome to SavingAdvice.com, a personal finance website that inspires and teaches different ways of saving money. SavingAdvice.com offers a little bit of everything from financial articles, discussion forums, blogs (you can even create your own), newsletters, calculators, and various other financial-related tools.

feeds.title: Clever Dude
feeds.description: The 'Dude' writes about his mistakes in finances and marriage in hopes that you, the reader, can learn just a few nuggets of wisdom and maybe prevent the same mistakes.

feeds.title: Dinks Finance
feeds.description: Dual Income No Kids (DINKs) Finance Blog is a personal finance blog by and for couples where you can learn about money, debt, & financial freedom. Our objective is to deliver high-quality personal finance news and advice that informs, empowers, educates, and entertains the public. We

feeds.title: Social Finance
feeds.description: Social Finance is national impact finance and advisory nonprofit. We work with the public, private, and social sectors to build innovative partnerships and investments that measurably improve lives. We are driven by the belief that social and economic systems should enable all people to thrive, and the conviction that we can create the most meaningful and measurable change in our communities.

feeds.title: Modern Frugality Blog
feeds.description: Here at Modern Frugality, we're all about redefining what it means to be frugal. We're passionate about getting out of debt, spending less, and investing wisely, but we're also about things you don't always associate with frugal living.

feeds.title: Money Saved is Money Earned
feeds.description: We're Sebastian and Tawnya, co-bloggers who will help you unlock the secrets of the financial world. We started this blog so we could share our knowledge of finance topics in order to help others understand finance and reach their money goals. Our goal is to teach people of all ages how financial systems work, and how to take advantage of these systems to save big money.
